### The Remedy for Sin
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-september-19-2026.html
Passage: Leviticus 17:11
Points:
- In ancient Israel, restoring broken fellowship with God required animal sacrifice.
- An unblemished animal was brought to the altar, and the sinner laid hands on it to symbolize the transfer of guilt.
- God appointed the shedding of blood to provide a covering and bring reconciliation.
- Christians must retain the centrality of blood in theology, as blood remains the only remedy for sin.

### The Day of Atonement
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-february-15-2024.html
Passage: Leviticus 17:11
Points:
- The Levitical sacrificial system answered how a holy God could dwell among sinful people.
- On the Day of Atonement, one goat died as a blood substitute while the scapegoat bore the people's sins away.
- God established that sinful people can only approach Him through the sacrifice of another.
- These rites pointed forward to Jesus, whose shed blood gives believers complete assurance before God.
